nA.text:
Watchlist dialog (replaces window.prompt)

• Salt Dialog. The same dialog serves New and Edit (scope menu › Edit <list>…, or the empty-state button).
• Picker = an InstrumentSearch variant: compact 30px rows, multi-select (checkbox), no channel cycling.
• Filters: Sector, Type, Exchange, Currency. Multi-select, no per-value counts.
• 'Add N matches' shows only once a search or filter is active, never for the whole universe. It snapshots the matches: instruments listed later are not added.
• Keyboard: Name → Tab → Search. ↑↓ move, Space add/remove, Ctrl+A add all matches. Tab → filters (↓ opens, Space toggles). Tab → selected list (Del removes). Ctrl+Enter creates, Esc cancels.
• Not proposed: a live list defined by the filter. That is what a saved FilterBar filter already is.

nB.text:
Column set = columns + quick filter fields

• Switching a footer tab swaps the visible columns AND the FilterBar's quick filter fields (QuickFilterProps.quickFilterColumns, controlled; onChangeQuickFilterColumns writes back to the active set).
• A quick filter field may name a column the set does not show ('filter only'), as long as the table has it.
• Values stay applied when you switch. A value on a field the new set doesn't show becomes a compact chip at the end of the bar (× clears it). Switching sets never silently changes the rows.
• The column picker gains a Quick filters tab. Both tabs save to the active set (Save / Revert, as today).
• New column set uses a Salt dialog (replaces window.prompt), with 'Include quick filters'.
• Sets saved before this change have no quickFilterColumns and keep today's defaults.

nC.text:
Column set scope

• New column set asks 'Available in': All watchlists (default) or Only <current scope>. All instruments is a scope too.
• Footer: shared tabs first, then a divider and the current scope's own tabs (small pin icon). Other scopes' sets are not shown.
• Tab context menu (or Shift+F10 on a focused tab): Rename, Duplicate, Share with all watchlists / Only in <scope>, Delete. Scope can be changed at any time.
• Each scope remembers its last active set; switching scope restores it. Fallback: the first shared set.
• Names are unique among the sets visible together (shared + one scope).
• Deleting a watchlist with its own sets: the confirm dialog lists them and offers to keep them as shared sets (unticked = deleted with the list).
• Storage: vuu ColumnSetsState unchanged; a side map {setName → scope} plus {scope → lastSet}. The model gets shared + current scope's sets and splits them back on save.
